rainbow.label: Rainbow accent
rainbow.help: Lets the accent colour cycle through the rainbow.

useBot.label: Send as bot account
useBot.help: Off: the broadcaster account sends the messages.

numberSeparator.label: Thousands separator
numberSeparator.help: Used when points are written into chat.

isChannelPointsTrigger.label: Triggered by channel points
isChannelPointsTrigger.help: On: the bet comes from the redemption, not from the chat input.

pointsVariable.label: Points variable
pointsVariable.help: The Streamer.bot user variable that holds the points.

pointsName.label: Points name
pointsName.help: How the points are called in chat messages.

defaultBet.label: Default bet
defaultBet.help: Used when a player gives no amount.

cpBetMode.label: Channel point bet
cpBetMode.help: input: the viewer types the amount. fixed: the fixed bet amount is used.

freeGame.label: Free game
freeGame.help: No points are taken or paid.

globalCooldown.label: Global cooldown
globalCooldown.help: Time before anyone can play again.

turnTimeout.label: Turn timeout
turnTimeout.help: How long a player may think before the game acts for them.

blockedGroups.label: Blocked groups
blockedGroups.help: Streamer.bot groups whose members cannot play.

addictedUsers.label: Addicted users
addictedUsers.help: These viewers win less, see the payout cut.

addictedPayoutCut.label: Addicted payout cut
addictedPayoutCut.help: How much of a win addicted viewers lose.

leaderboardResetScope.label: Reset scope
leaderboardResetScope.help: all: one board. platform: one board per platform.

autoStartEnabled.label: Start rounds automatically
autoStartEnabled.help: Switches the Streamer.bot timed action that starts a round on and off.

autoStartIntervalMinutes.label: Every
autoStartIntervalMinutes.help: How long between automatic rounds. With a random time, the shortest wait.

autoStartRandom.label: Random time
autoStartRandom.help: Each wait is drawn anew, between Every and At most, so chat cannot tell when the next round comes.

autoStartIntervalMaxMinutes.label: At most
autoStartIntervalMaxMinutes.help: The longest wait of a random time.

autoStartMinChatLines.label: Only after chat lines
autoStartMinChatLines.help: How many lines chat must have written since the last automatic round. Too few, and the round waits for the next turn of the timer. 0 asks for none.

adBreakStart.label: Start a round when ads start
adBreakStart.help: Twitch only. When an ad break starts on your channel, a round starts with it: chat stays usable while the ads run.

adBreakAnnounce.label: Announce it before the ads
adBreakAnnounce.help: A line in chat ahead of the ad break, so viewers know a round comes with it.

adBreakAnnounceMinutes.label: Minutes before
adBreakAnnounceMinutes.help: How long before the ads the line is sent, 1 to 5. Twitch tells of an ad break from five minutes ahead.

adBreakBonusPercent.label: Bonus during ads
adBreakBonusPercent.help: How much more a round started during an ad break pays, as a percentage. 0 for none.

adBreakOnly.label: Rounds only during ads
adBreakOnly.help: Twitch only. Viewers can start a round only while ads run; moderators and the broadcaster always can.

overlayFolder.label: Overlay folder
overlayFolder.help: Where the overlay files are written. Empty uses the default next to Streamer.bot.

logToFile.label: Write a log file per day
logToFile.help: One file per day in the game's log folder.

obsConnectionId.label: OBS connection
obsConnectionId.help: The number of the OBS connection in Streamer.bot; 0 is the first.

setupObsOverlay.label: Create the browser source in OBS

refundFailedRedemptions.label: Refund redemptions that don't play
refundFailedRedemptions.help: The channel points go back when the redemption does not turn into a game.

subscriberBoostPercent.label: Subscriber boost
subscriberBoostPercent.help: In percent; the field adds the unit.

vipBoostPercent.label: VIP boost
vipBoostPercent.help: In percent; the field adds the unit.

rewardId.label: Reward ID
rewardId.help: The id of the channel point reward; the game fills it in when it creates the reward.

placeholders.medal: Medal emoji for the top three, else empty

ui.field.path.tip: A relative path starts in the Streamer.bot folder.
ui.help.triggers.note: For actions of your own: add one of these as a trigger (Custom, in the trigger menu) and the action runs when it happens, with the arguments listed. The button fires a trigger once with the sample values in brackets, so you can try your action without playing a round.
ui.help.trigger.fire.tip: Runs every action of yours that listens to this trigger, once, with the sample values. The game itself does nothing.
ui.help.trigger.notFired.why: The game did not answer. It may run an older version than this window: import its current version.
ui.help.methods.note: Add an Execute C# Method sub-action to any action, pick the code of the {0} action and one of these methods. Set an argument before it to pass something in; read one after it for what came out.
ui.log.search.tip: Finds names, platforms, results and amounts.
ui.log.line.tip: The whole line behind the entry picked above.
ui.about.updateNotices.tip: Once per Streamer.bot start, one notice names what is new: UIFramework and the games that start with Streamer.bot. It goes to every connected chat, or comes as a Windows notification while no broadcaster account is connected. The links are in Streamer.bot's log. Off: this game is left out.
ui.update.chat: 🔔 Updates are out: {updates}. Details are in Streamer.bot's log.
ui.update.toast.title: Updates for Streamer.bot
ui.messages.numbers.tip: The thousands separator used in every amount that is posted.
ui.messages.botAccount.tip:
Sends the messages from your Streamer.bot bot account instead of the broadcaster account.
(Platforms > Any platform > Accounts > Bot)
ui.messages.sendMe.tip: Twitch only: YouTube and Kick have no /me, so there the messages always go out as plain chat.
ui.messages.cooldownBot.tip: Sends the cooldown replies from your bot account, separately from the other messages.
ui.messages.cooldownMe.tip: Twitch only, and separate from the other messages.
ui.messages.noPlaceholders: Sent as written: this one has no placeholders.
ui.messages.preview.note: The preview fills every placeholder with a sample, so a stray brace or a misspelt name shows up here before chat sees it.
ui.cust.drag.field: Drag to another place on this page, or onto a page in the rail. Let go at the left or right edge of another field to put it beside that one, at its top or bottom for a line of its own.

ui.cust.noTemplates: This host has no message templates.

ui.cust.accent.tip: The highlight colour of this and every other UIFramework window: the blue buttons, switches that are on, the active page in the rail, links and this bar. Empty: the default blue.
ui.cust.helpLines.tip: Shows each field's help as a line under it instead of in its tooltip.
ui.cust.resetLayout.confirm: Forget every renamed, moved and hidden page and field? The theme stays.
ui.cust.export.tip: Write the saved settings to a file of your choosing
ui.cust.import.tip: Replace the saved settings with an exported file, or a settings file; the file as it was is kept as .bak

ui.cust.layoutFailed.title: Customise
ui.tip.tour: Show the tour of this window
ui.search.hint: Type a word of a setting's name or of its help. Several words narrow it down.
ui.search.keys: ↑ ↓ to move, Enter to go there, Esc to close
ui.tour.search.title: Search
ui.tour.search.text: Ctrl+F, or the magnifier, finds a setting, a message or a page by any word of its name or its help, and takes you there.
ui.tour.start.title: A quick tour
ui.tour.start.text: What this window can do, in a few steps. Next goes on, Esc ends the tour; the ? at the top right shows it again whenever you like.
ui.tour.end.title: That's it
ui.tour.end.text: Change what you like and save: the game uses the new settings from its next run.
ui.tour.rail.title: Pages
ui.tour.rail.text: Every page of the settings is here; click one to open it. Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+9 jump straight to the first nine.
ui.tour.save.title: Save
ui.tour.save.text: Writes the settings; the game reads them on its next run. Ctrl+S does the same.
ui.tour.saveExit.title: Save & Exit
ui.tour.saveExit.text: Saves and closes the window in one go.
ui.tour.cancel.title: Cancel
ui.tour.cancel.text: Closes the window without saving; it asks first when something is not saved yet.
ui.tour.status.title: Unsaved changes
ui.tour.status.text: Here the window says how many changes are not saved yet, and whether a save went through.
ui.tour.reset.title: Reset everything
ui.tour.reset.text: Puts every setting on every page back to its default. It asks before it does.
ui.tour.resetPage.title: Reset this page
ui.tour.resetPage.text: Puts only the settings of the page in front back to their defaults; nothing is written until you save.
ui.tour.theme.title: Light or dark
ui.tour.theme.text: Switches between the light and the dark theme.
ui.tour.customise.title: Customise
ui.tour.customise.text: Rename, move and hide fields and pages to your liking, pick an accent colour, and show the help under each field instead of in its tooltip. Export and import of the settings live there too. Your layout survives every update of the game.
ui.tour.tour.title: This tour
ui.tour.tour.text: The ? shows this tour again whenever you want it.
ui.tour.page.text: One of the window's pages; click it in the rail to open it.
ui.tour.page.messages.text: What the game writes into chat. The chips are placeholders the game fills in; the preview shows a message the way chat will see it.
ui.tour.page.log.text: What the game has written to its log, newest first, with filters.
ui.tour.page.help.text: The game's commands and how it is played.
ui.tour.page.about.text: Version, links and credits. A newer version of the game shows up here too.
